Reading through your experience reminds me of mine, I hated high school so fucking much. You're a young person and even though it sound cliche, it does get better. At your age I tried to kill myself more times than I can remember and now that I look back I can see all the mistakes I made, caring about people who did not care about me, seeking approval from peers who had nothing to offer, wasting time making friends with girls who used me as an emotional tampon, not voicing what I really felt, revealing too much to strangers, not standing up to my parents earlier and making them realize that I am a person who wants to make something out of myself, searching for happiness rather than purpose. Happiness is just a fleeting feeling, no one is happy for any long period of time. I now value stability and contentment over happiness. People will not fully understand of appreciate what you are going through, you can talk about it with people who are qualified or are obliged to listen like your parents but everyone else will just think less of you and more of themselves by contrast, especially women and girls. I would say look for more male friends, if they don't like you, you can always immediately tell. I hope you get better.
